recentItems.title: RAJA RAJA RAJA KAREJA MEIN SAMAJA | VINOD RATHOD, KALPANA | BHOJPURI SONG
recentItems.description:
Enjoy “Raja Raja Raja Kareja Mein Samaja”, a melodious Bhojpuri romantic song featuring the soulful voices of Vinod Rathod and Kalpana. Composed by Rajesh Gupta and penned by Vinay Bihari, this beautiful track captures the warmth and emotions of love.

Featuring Ravi Kishan and Kunal Singh, this song brings the charm of Bhojpuri cinema to music lovers.

Listen, enjoy, and share this romantic Bhojpuri song with your friends and family!
